notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
Hi Players,

We have been working hard to make this game fun based on the community feedabck, and here are what we have updated.

Ranged insect monster reduced it's attack range.
Alien monster stop further from player than before.
Points get from block count set the maximum of 1000. 
Added upgradable attack power feature to Michelle. 
Added current player on multiplayer tab.
Removed tutorial requirement on challenge mode.
Changed order of main menu.

Fixed 'Not enough point' text blocks weapon selection.
Fixed wrong incorrect health silhouette on challenge mode.

Enjoy!
